summary: The candidate captures nearly all core definitions, main theorems, supporting lemmas, and cited external results in mathematically recognizable form, with generally accurate pages and attribution. It is not flawless because several entries are duplicated, some entry classes are wrong, one duplicate of Theorem 2.4 weakens a modular condition, and the Bauer and Taubes external results are compressed enough to omit important hypotheses or conclusions.
strengths: Faithfully captures the main results Theorems 1.4, 1.9, 2.3, and 2.8, including their essential hypotheses and conclusions.
Captures the foundational definitions of geometric simple connectivity and representation by a 2-handle neighborhood.
Includes the crucial supporting Lemmas 2.6 and 3.1 and the Frøyshov vanishing theorem.
Correctly marks most literature-derived results as external and supplies useful source references.
Adds legitimate corollaries and auxiliary results beyond the Gold core, giving strong overall coverage.
Most principal theorem and definition page locators agree with the source.
issues: Five IDs are duplicated: the geometric-simple-connectivity definition and Lemmas/Theorems 2.6, 3.1, 2.3, and 2.4; additional near-duplicate definitions further reduce delimitation quality.
The second copy of Theorem 2.4 states $b_2^+\ne1$ instead of $b_2^+\not\equiv1\pmod4$, producing an inconsistent and mathematically weaker/incorrect condition.
Theorem 2.7 is overly compressed into a reference to conditions (2)(i)-(iii), omitting the explicit hypotheses and the special mod-8 condition when $n=4$.

The Taubes entries do not faithfully recover the Gold statement about the canonical $\mathrm{spin}^c$ structure and $SW_X(s_X)=\pm1\equiv1\pmod2$; one substitutes a less precise nonvanishing statement with an added $b_2^+>1$ restriction.
The Gold definition of a symplectic structure and its induced canonical orientation and $\mathrm{spin}^c$ structure is not independently extracted.
Problem 1.1 is incorrectly typed as a lemma, while Corollaries 1.5, 1.6, 1.7, and 2.5 are typed as theorems rather than corollaries.
One duplicated geometric-simple-connectivity definition is assigned to page 10 even though the actual definition occurs on page 1.
The page-9 2-handle-neighborhood definition is an imprecise duplicate that omits the detailed subhandlebody and homology-map formulation.

The core orientation-dependent symplectic obstruction is captured, though the shared mod-4 scope could be written more explicitly.
